## Description

Optional --type with --id; --type+--subject targeting on get/update/supersede; default --expected-revision @current; --expected-revision on correct.

## Approach

Wire argparse defaults and shared target resolution using existing `_find_record_by_id` / subject match. Default expected-revision to @current on update/supersede/contradict; add optional flag on correct as predecessor guard. Tests for id-only mutator, subject targeting, and default @current path.
